name: ux-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the UX design verification for the checked-in contract example. Run `python3 $UX_PLUGIN/scripts/ux_launcher.py gates <contract>` on the workspace contract (or `python -m ux_creator gates <contract>`), compare the verdicts to the recorded ones in out/<name>/ux-report.json, and write a short result to observations/ux/. If any gate regressed from pass to fail or unknown, say so explicitly in the run summary.
